properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated December 13, [1933]; includes opinions about Pan American Airways operations in China, personnel, and equipment; visit with the passengers injured in the accident at Zhoushan Island [aircraft registration number NC16V]; mentions Dai [Enki] and Ki Chun.
